filters.label: PGA Min Prominence
filters.description: Filter PGA events with prominence (scipy find_peaks prominence on the broadband contrast-summed envelope) below the threshold. Catches noise events with no real attack.

filters.label: Min Decay Col-Min (dB)
filters.description: Filter PGA events with decay_col_min_median_db below the threshold. Catches single-frame noise pops with no sustained ring. Empirically: real toms strikes -60 to -84 dB, noise pops -84 to -90 dB. -80 dB is the safe cut between the two clusters.

filters.label: Attack Rise Max (ms)
filters.description: Filter PGA events with attack_rise_ms above the threshold. Catches wire-tail / step-back FPs that the prominence + decay_col_min filters miss — these have real-looking attack but the high-res STFT detects they 'step back' to a previous attack, producing an unusually long 10-90% rise time. Empirically (project 6, Taylor Swift toms): all real hits have attack_rise < 20ms; FPs cluster at 100-500ms (the longer the rise, the more the FP is 'stepping back' to the real attack).
